note: DESIGN.md carries no YAML frontmatter, so token primitives live here under `tokens`, one block per world. `studio` applies at / (globals.css :root and [data-theme='dark']); `tutor` applies only inside .tutor (src/app/tutoring/tutor.css) at tuition.hafeezstudio.com.

components.name: Tutor Book Button

components.css: .ds-t-book { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 54px; padding: 0 26px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1F6B48; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-t-book:hover { background: #17563A; } .ds-t-book:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1F6B48; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tutor Quiet Link

narrative.northStar: Studio: minimal and typographic. Tutor: one plain white page, one green button.
narrative.overview: Minimal and typographic. Well-set words, real client screens and honest prices do the persuading. Applies to the studio site (/). The tutoring site is a separate business with its own plain white world: one short column that says what is offered, to whom, where and for how much. Nothing is decorated.
keyCharacteristics: Studio: type carries the page; hairlines separate content; one ink-blue accent; one primary action per view.
Tutor: white ground, green-tinted ink, one deep green for the button, list markers and step numbers; a single 720px column with hairlines between sections; no motion beyond the button hover.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Deep green marks the book button, the list markers and step numbers, the WhatsApp glyph in the top line and the focus ring. Text is ink or soft ink, never green.

rules.name: The Bare Page Rule
rules.body: No images, cards, shadows or gradients. Sections are separated by a hairline and whitespace only.
